deploy-bot: Scheduled migration 'add_orders_customer_id' will run on prod at 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC (maintenance window). Rollout ID: r-9421. Operators: @Alice W., @Ben L.. If any step fails, automatic rollback disabled - manual rollback plan required.

Alice W.: Confirming. What's lock strategy? long-running LOCK TABLE? We should avoid exclusive locks.

Ben L.: This migration adds a nullable column + backfill. Plan was online: add column, background backfill in batches, then set NOT NULL and add FK.

Carlos M.: Backfill perf notes: previous run at 1000 qps hit db CPU at 80%. I'll run a small sim on staging and post numbers.

Dana S.: Agree batch size must be adaptive. Suggest using the backfill worker with rate-limit and sleep between batches. Also we should pin app to v2.14 during migration to avoid reading the new column before it's populated.

Emma T.: Can we canary the backfill to 1% of tenant traffic first and watch timeouts? Also add a feature flag gate for read-path check.

Ben L.: rollback plan: if backfill causes >5% error rate or replication lag >2s, stop workers, revert to app pinned build that ignores the new column. Rollback command: 

```bash
# stop backfill
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/backfill-workers --replicas=0
# pin frontend
cictl deploy --service=frontend --image=redwood/frontend:v2.13.7 --reason='pin during migration'
# db revert (manual - only if necessary)
psql $PROD_DB -c "ALTER TABLE orders DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS customer_id;"
```

Alice W.: Need migration lock considerations: use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY for index adds and add FK as NOT VALID then VALIDATE after backfill. Avoid any ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN with a table rewrite.

Carlos M.: I'll prepare a staged backfill job with metrics: batches/sec, rows/sec, db_cpu, replication_lag. Will post dashboard link when ready.

deploy-bot: Reminder: change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. If you need to extend, raise in #incidents. Rollout ID r-9421.

Dana S.: I'll own the rollback runbook and add exact query to check orphaned rows. Also adding the post-mortem checklist in the release notes draft.

Emma T.: Putting a canary on 1% at 02:05, then 10% at 02:20, full at 02:40 if green. I'll update the rollout steps and add runbook checks at each step.

Ben L.: OK locking strategy: no exclusive locks, use NOT VALID FK then validate. Agree to pin version. I'll be on-call during the window.

Alice W.: sounds good. approve :thumbsup:

Ben L.: tagging @Carlos M. and @Dana S. to confirm monitoring alerts thresholds and runbook links before EOD.

Carlos M.: Will post staging sim results + dashboard by 18:00 PT.

Dana S.: Added rollback runbook to the release doc and noted the pinned image tag.

deploy-bot: Deploy job r-9421 queued. Next update will be a status message at T-30m.
